molecule_89/ref.substituent_description: Pyrrolo[2,3-d]pyrimidin-4-one: pyrrole N bears Me, the adjacent carbon bears I; pyrimidinone N3 carries CH2 to C4 of a 4-hydroxypiperidine. The piperidine N is acylated by C(=O) attached by a solid wedge to C4 of a second piperidine, whose C3 bears Ph on a hashed bond and whose N bears Boc.
molecule_89/ref.notes: Typeset. Double bonds: N=CH, C7a=C4a, C(I)=CH, ring C=O, amide C=O.
